source: Owner-requested day-center activity repertoire and flexible front-of-room layout, September 2026; concurrent Chinese-American cultural zones with guest instructors, October 2026. Illustrative rotation, not a verified daily timetable.
layoutNote: Three front tables and their twelve chairs are cleared for a flexible activity floor, and the static tabletop sets on the long arts table and tea-corner tables 01–03 give way to session props. The original furniture plan remains in the source comparison. Other tables remain for small groups and quieter participation.

instructors.name: Ms. Leung
instructors.attire: Opera costume with water sleeves and headdress

programs.label: Cantonese opera
programs.title: Cantonese opera & familiar songs
programs.culture: A guest performer in full opera costume sings Cantonese opera excerpts; water-sleeve gestures and familiar songs invite requests from the room.
programs.access: Watch, clap or join in from a chair, wheelchair or standing position.

programs.label: Baduanjin qigong
programs.title: Baduanjin qigong · the Eight Brocades
programs.culture: Eight slow, named movements such as 'holding up the heavens', led by a qigong teacher in practice silks.
programs.access: Every movement has a seated version; rest whenever needed.

programs.label: Device class
programs.title: Everyday device skills
programs.culture: Practice WeChat and video calls with family, photos and larger text using step-by-step visual prompts.
programs.access: One-to-one help, a supported tablet and repeatable small steps.

programs.label: Exercise
programs.title: Everyday movement
programs.culture: A staff-led group with familiar music and easy-to-follow demonstrations.
programs.access: Standing, chair-based or wheelchair upper-body movement; rest whenever needed.

programs.label: Fan dance
programs.title: Fan dance
programs.culture: Silk folding fans open, turn and flutter to Chinese folk music, led by a dance teacher in a qipao.
programs.access: Standing steps or seated fan and arm movements.

programs.label: Tai chi
programs.title: Tai chi together
programs.culture: Yang-style 'cloud hands' and slow weight shifts, led by a teacher in white practice silks.
programs.access: A seated version mirrors the upper-body sequence; a care aide stays nearby.

programs.label: Language circle
programs.title: Language circle & lantern riddles
programs.culture: Riddles hung on red lanterns and familiar sayings in Cantonese, Mandarin and English; a bilingual host reads each one aloud.
programs.access: Listen, point to a picture or speak at your own pace.

programs.label: Ribbon dance
programs.title: Silk ribbon dance
programs.culture: Long silk ribbons trace circles and waves to folk melodies.
programs.access: Short ribbons and seated arm patterns are available.

programs.label: Erhu & sing-along
programs.title: Erhu & sing-along
programs.culture: A two-string erhu leads favorite folk songs; participants keep time with shakers and a hand drum.
programs.access: Lightweight shakers and a supported hand drum; listening is welcome.

programs.label: TCM talk
programs.title: TCM & seasonal wellness talk
programs.culture: A TCM practitioner explains seasonal foods, herbal teas and acupressure points with a wall chart; the host interprets questions.
programs.access: Seated listening, visual prompts and time for questions; a quiet table option stays available.

programs.label: Calligraphy
programs.title: Calligraphy & brushwork
programs.culture: Brush, ink stone and rice paper: practising personally meaningful characters with a calligraphy teacher.
programs.access: Thick-handled brushes, supported paper and hand-over-hand help when requested.

programs.label: Paper-cutting
programs.title: Paper-cutting
programs.culture: Folding and cutting red paper into window flowers and the character 福, good fortune.
programs.access: Pre-drawn patterns, spring-loaded scissors, or tearing instead of cutting.

programs.label: Ink painting
programs.title: Ink painting
programs.culture: Bamboo, plum blossom and orchid in black ink, one brushstroke at a time.

programs.label: Lantern making
programs.title: Lantern making
programs.culture: Folding red paper lanterns for the next festival; finished lanterns hang over the activity floor.
programs.access: Pre-cut pieces and glue sticks; work in pairs.

programs.label: Spring couplets
programs.title: Spring couplets
programs.culture: Writing paired good-wish verses on red paper, as families do for Lunar New Year.
programs.access: Thick-handled brushes, supported paper and hand-over-hand help when requested.

programs.label: Morning tea & papers
programs.title: Morning tea & Chinese newspapers
programs.culture: Jasmine and oolong tea with Chinese-language newspapers; the tea host refills cups and starts conversations about the day's news.
programs.access: Large-print papers; reading aloud is welcome.

programs.label: Gongfu tea
programs.title: Gongfu tea
programs.culture: Small-pot gongfu tea poured in rounds, with time to talk about family, food and festivals.
programs.access: Light cups with handles; caffeine-free chrysanthemum tea on request.
